title: Romantic Miami Helicopter Tour with Champagne
includes: Spectacular aerial views of Miami and its stunning coastline
Capture the moment: Photos and videos are allowed!
Highly experienced commercial helicopter pilot as your personal guide
Private Helicopter Experience – Only your group will be on the flight.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Passenger Weight: Combined weight of all passengers must not exceed 500 pounds (230 kg). Maximum weight per passenger is 250 pounds (113 kg). Exceeding these limits will result in one passenger being excluded, with no refunds.
All passengers must bring a valid photo ID. It could be a Driver’s License or Passport.
policies: Arrive 30 minutes in advance to the time your tour is reserved for check in procedure.

The person that paid for this booking must be present at the time of the flight and show ID and credit card.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Fly in comfort aboard our luxury black R44 helicopter ensuring an unforgettable experience in the sky. Perfect for visitors, couples, families or friends, this tour provides a magical perspective of Miami’s most iconic landmarks.
Upon arrival at the airport, you’ll be welcomed with a complimentary bottle of champagne. Then, step aboard your private luxury helicopter—champagne in hand—and prepare for a spectacular flight. As you soar over Miami, take in sweeping views of Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, and the exclusive Palm and Venetian Islands. Glide past South Beach, Downtown Miami, and the sparkling waters of Biscayne Bay. Fly above the lush beauty of Key Biscayne while watching for dolphins, manatees, sharks, and other marine life below.
Whether you're visiting Miami or celebrating a special occasion, this luxury private romantic helicopter flight offers the most breathtaking aerial views of the Magic City.
